Tax Summary

The Tax Summary report provides a comprehensive overview of all tax transactions within a specified period.

This report groups transactions by tax code, showing both tax collected from sales and tax paid on purchases.

Purpose and Benefits

Use this report to analyze your tax position for each tax code in your system.

The report helps you understand your net tax liability or refund position by comparing tax collected versus tax paid.

This information is essential for preparing tax returns and ensuring compliance with tax regulations.

Report Configuration

Configure the report parameters below to generate a tax summary for your desired period and accounting method.

You can filter by division if you need tax information for specific segments of your business.

Description

Report Details

Add an optional description or note that will appear on the report.

This can be useful for documenting the purpose of the report or any special circumstances.

From

Reporting Period

Enter the starting date for the tax summary period.

This determines the beginning of the date range for which tax transactions will be included in the report.

To

Enter the ending date for the tax summary period.

This determines the end of the date range for which tax transactions will be included in the report.

Accounting method

Accounting Method

Select whether to use accrual or cash basis accounting for this report.

Accrual basis recognizes transactions when they occur, regardless of payment.

Cash basis recognizes transactions only when payment is made or received.

Division

Filtering Options

Select a specific division to filter the tax summary, or leave blank to include all divisions.

This is useful when you need tax information for a particular segment of your business.
